# apipbx_firewall_carrier (Resource)

A carrier whose servers always reach the voice services (SIP, SIP over TLS, WebRTC, IAX2 and RTP), even when those are restricted to your own networks. Use a built-in template (provider_id = "magrathea") or a custom carrier (provider_id = "custom" with sources and/or hosts). A template brings the provider's gateways and every address block it announces; host names are resolved every few minutes. Import with the carrier id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) A template id (magrathea) or custom. GET /v1/firewall/providers lists the templates.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `hosts` (Set of String) Host names (resolved) or addresses, added to the template's gateways.
- `name` (String) Defaults to the template's name.
- `sources` (Set of String) Added to the template's address blocks; all there is for a custom carrier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
